# Module 12 — collections, part 2

Allowed: modules 1–11, plus `Map`, `HashMap`, `TreeMap`, `TreeSet`, `Comparable`, `Comparator` written as a class or an anonymous class, `Collections.sort`, and searching.

Do not suggest or require: regular expressions, lambda expressions, method references, `Optional`, the Date-Time API, the Stream API, `List.sort` with a lambda, threads, files, or web APIs.

Do not ask to replace a loop over a collection with a stream.
